title: Sanitize User Input — Companion Resources
title_es: Sanitizar Input de Usuario — Recursos complementarios
description: Runnable input-sanitization demos: a Node.js path-traversal guard, a NoSQL query operator stripper, and a Python magic-byte upload validator.
